title: Nonadaptive string tester
statement: For an alphabet $A$ and natural numbers $n$ and $r$, a nonadaptive string tester is a nonadaptive function tester whose domain is the set of positions $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$ and whose codomain is $A$, with $r$ query positions.
caveat: The supplied material does not define the underlying nonadaptive function tester, so its full mathematical meaning is unavailable.
